preconditions.description: Attacker must be an authorized address (owner or authorized account) to call performairdrop function
Attacker must have some MetaApes tokens to use as 'from' address in airdrop

exploit_hint: As an authorized attacker, call the performairdrop function with your own address as 'from' and specify recipient addresses (including your own) with token amounts. The function will transfer tokens without proper access control checks, allowing you to distribute tokens arbitrarily. You can airdrop tokens to yourself or other addresses without proper authorization validation.
